title: Rav Simona
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman says he is not mentioned in the Gemara, but only in the Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon, part 2, chapter 4, which relates that Rav Eina and Rav Simona introduced several lines of reasoning into the Gemara.
Seder Tannaim veAmoraim says that they fixed the chapters of all the teaching in their order; see Dorot HaRishonim, part 3, chapter 17, which treats this at length.

notes.text: The phrase concerns chapters of teaching, not a new claim about chapters belonging to every Tanna. All supplied name and transmitter distinctions remain.
